title_sq: Ambjent komercial 300m2 te mbikalimi i Komunes se Parisit
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 300m2 i pershtatshem per zyra apo klinike. 
Disponon 7 hapesira te pershtatshme si ambjente pune, salle mbledhjesh, dhome skaneri e izoluar, recepsion qe ben shperndarjen ne ambjentet e tjera, 3 tualete ne total dhe dalje ne ballkon ne cdo dhome. 
Inevestimet aktuale jane teper cilesore dhe te mirembajtura; zona ne te cilen ndodhet eshte lehtesisht e aksesueshme dhe ka mundesi reklamimi shume te mire pasi sheh nga rruga kryesore. 
Gjithashtu, vlere e shtuar eshte edhe hyrja e dedikuar si dhe sistemi i kamerave te sigurise. 
Per me teper informacion, na kontaktoni!
title_en: Commercial space 300m2 at the overpass of the Municipality of Paris
description_en: 300m2 apartment for sale, suitable for offices or clinics. It has 7 suitable spaces such as work areas, meeting rooms, isolated scanner room, reception that distributes to other areas, 3 toilets in total and access to the balcony in each room. Current investments are high quality and well maintained; the area in which it is located is easily accessible and has very good advertising opportunities since it is visible from the main road. Also, added value is the dedicated entrance as well as the security camera system. For more information, contact us!
